response: Yes, the Androgen Deficiency of Aging Men (ADAM) questionnaire is useful for the screening of partial androgenic deficiency of aging men. It is a 10-item questionnaire that helps identify symptoms of androgen deficiency, such as decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, and decreased muscle strength, in older men. While it is not a definitive diagnostic tool, the ADAM questionnaire can be a helpful screening instrument to identify men who may benefit from further evaluation and potential treatment for androgen deficiency.
